def gate(data, nginx=False):
    samples = data['runs']
    left = samples[::2] if nginx else [r for r in samples if r['engine'] == 'rgnix']
    right = samples[1::2] if nginx else [r for r in samples if r['engine'] == 'candidate']
    pairs = [200 * abs(a['rps'] - b['rps']) / (a['rps'] + b['rps'])
             for a, b in zip(left, right)]
    cvs = [100 * statistics.stdev(r['rps'] for r in group) /
           statistics.mean(r['rps'] for r in group) for group in [left, right]]
    return {'paired_difference_pct': pairs, 'cv_pct': cvs,
            'passed': len(pairs) == 3 and max(pairs + cvs) <= 10 and
                      all(r['errors'] == 0 for r in samples)}
